walkthrough:
From the stem-and-leaf diagram for group A, locate the median of the ordered reaction times:
$$\text{Median} = 0.225\text{ seconds}$$

Determine the lower quartile ($Q_1$) and upper quartile ($Q_3$) for group A:
$$\begin{aligned} Q_1 &= 0.215\text{ seconds} \\ Q_3 &= 0.236\text{ seconds} \end{aligned}$$

Compute the interquartile range ($IQR$):
$$IQR = Q_3 - Q_1 = 0.236 - 0.215 = 0.021\text{ seconds}$$

ai_rubric.Finding Medians and Quartiles: Find median = 0.225 s, lower quartile = 0.215 s, upper quartile = 0.236 s, and IQR = 0.021 s.

teacher_walkthrough: From the back-to-back stem-and-leaf diagram, we read the reaction times in seconds for group A in ascending order.

Step 1: Find the median.
The median is the middle observation of group A: $\text{Median} = 0.225$ seconds.

Step 2: Find the lower quartile ($Q_1$) and upper quartile ($Q_3$):
- Lower quartile: $Q_1 = 0.215$ seconds
- Upper quartile: $Q_3 = 0.236$ seconds

Step 3: Calculate the Interquartile Range ($IQR$):
$$IQR = Q_3 - Q_1 = 0.236 - 0.215 = 0.021\text{ seconds}$$

teacher_walkthrough: A box-and-whisker plot requires a five-number summary: minimum value, lower quartile ($Q_1$), median, upper quartile ($Q_3$), and maximum value.

Step 1: Summarise Group A:
- Minimum $= 0.200$
- Lower quartile ($Q_1$) $= 0.215$
- Median $= 0.225$
- Upper quartile ($Q_3$) $= 0.236$
- Maximum $= 0.250$

Step 2: Summarise Group B:
- Minimum $= 0.205$
- Lower quartile ($Q_1$) $= 0.217$
- Median $= 0.235$
- Upper quartile ($Q_3$) $= 0.245$
- Maximum $= 0.258$

Step 3: Construct the plots:
- Use a shared horizontal axis with a linear scale from $0.20$ to $0.26$, labelled 'Time (seconds)'.
- For each group, draw a box between $Q_1$ and $Q_3$ with a vertical line marking the median.
- Draw horizontal whiskers extending from the ends of the box to the minimum and maximum values.
- Label each plot clearly as 'Group A' and 'Group B'.
